Is the new BMW 3 Series an absolute game-changer?!
Meet the all-new BMW 3 Series!
Mat's flown over to Germany for his chance to get hands-on with the new 3 Series and all-electric BMW i3.
So the question is, just how different is the all-electric i3 compared to the petrol-powered 3 Series? And if you’re in the market for one of these newly released exports, which should you go for? Let’s take a closer look…
